fields.ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)

power_management_states.name: Active
power_management_states.description: Sensor transmitting frames (or responding to SPC triggers).

power_management_states.name: Idle
power_management_states.description: Signal line high between pulses; in SENT-SPC the sensor idles until triggered.

fields.wakeup_mechanism: In basic SENT the sensor free-runs while powered. In SENT-SPC the sensor responds to the ECU master trigger pulse, so it can idle between triggers and wake on the trigger edge.

power_rails.purpose: Sensor supply via the supply wire.
Push-pull driver of the SENT signal wire.

fields.sent_power_considerations: SENT defines a simple three-wire supply (signal + 5 V supply + ground). Basic SENT transmits continuously; SENT-SPC allows the sensor to idle between ECU triggers to save power. Detailed rails and low-power behavior are sensor-implementation concerns.
fields.notes: SENT's protocol-level power intent is minimal: a 5 V supply over the three-wire interface, continuous transmission in basic SENT, and trigger-gated activity in SENT-SPC. Fine-grained power-domain control is a sensor / SoC concern.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
